'''Shane Watner Mantellian Slim''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Shane Watner]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-6250">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6250 Mantellian Slim], DeckTech (Shane "Outlaw" Watner, 2 May 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/6250/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/6250/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018174429/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6250/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Mantellian Slim'''
* '''Author:''' Shane "Outlaw" Watner
* '''Published:''' May 2, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Mains beatdown with Mantellian Savrip and some retieval

=== Strategy ===

Usually start with Careful Planning and Obi's Hut and Cantina or Audience Chamber if playing against Court.  Use DoS with Reflection at Yoda's Hut.  Give her Anikins Saber and Lightsaber Pro to drain at the hut.  Use Electrobinoculars for On The Edge.  Dont worry bout losing mains to Mantellin Savrip cause there is plenty of Retreival to get them back.
